units: <cite ref="Pesachim 111a:7">Pes. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>גְּמוּד מסאניה</he> (Ms. M. <he>גמד</he>) his shoes shrank (became too tight).
<cite ref="Gittin 57a:13">Gitt. 57ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="C01003"><he>גמדא</he></cite> the land shrinks, opp. <he>רווחא</he>.

Yoma 69ᵃ; Bets. 15ᵃ האי נמטא גמדא דנרש וכ׳ the shrunk (hard) mattress of Narash (which does not warm) is permitted (does not come under the law of כִּלְאַיִם).—Part. pass. גְּמִיד contracted, atrophied.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 3:15">Targ. Jud. III, 15</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 20:16">XX, 16</cite> (h. text <cite ref="A01102"><he>אִטֵּר</he></cite> q. v.).
